state_management_issue.description: Zustand store does not persist state across page navigations
state_management_issue.affected_flow: Eveil frequency/memory selections → Territoire role derivation
state_management_issue.expected_behavior: When user selects 'Musique' frequency in Eveil, the role in Territoire should show 'GRIOT' (derived from frequencies array in store)
state_management_issue.actual_behavior: Role shows 'EXPLORATEUR' (default when frequencies array is empty) because store resets to initial state on each page navigation
state_management_issue.root_cause: No persistence middleware in zustand store (/app/frontend/src/store/useKoraStore.ts). Store initializes with empty arrays (frequencies: [], memories: []) on every mount.
state_management_issue.suggested_fix: Add zustand persist middleware to save/restore state from localStorage/AsyncStorage
state_management_issue.priority: MEDIUM - Not related to Prompt 9 polish pass, existing limitation from earlier iterations
